Definition: from G3030; frankincense, i.e. (by extension) a censer for burning it:--censer.
BiblicalUsage: libanōtós means censer. In Revelation 8:3, "having a golden censer"; and in Revelation 8:5, "And the angel took the censer".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the golden censer is the picture of prayer — incense rises with the prayers of the saints, and fire from the same altar falls on the earth.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
